scope: Unify trash/excluded source checkbox selection, replace scrolling action text with a fixed contextual AppBar and select-all row; no archive-row detail/edit entry.
coverage_note: 88 related tests passed (home 54, shell/calendar/widget 6, lists 6, eCampus 22). After final count/checkbox alignment polish, both affected scope tests passed again with rendering, scrolling, select-all, row/checkbox taps and hardware-back assertions. Counts overlap.
earlier_run_note: First: existing affected 14 tests passed. Controls: 3 passed but a post-scroll test tap missed its target, weakening the hardware-back assertion. The test now resets the actual scroll position, checks hitTestable and asserts selection has reopened before pressing back. Final/capture runs have no missed-tap warnings.

analysis.capture_method: Exact stdout copied from direct flutter analyze --no-pub output

behavior.entry: Both trash and excluded rows always have left checkboxes. Tapping any row area toggles it; neither opens Task details. Normal Task details/completion remain unchanged.
behavior.header: Selection replaces the normal toolbar and section heading/count with a pinned AppBar: back + numeric count + action icons; pinned select-all checkbox row below. Count left-aligned, checkbox aligned with row checkboxes.
behavior.trash_actions: Restore and delete icon buttons. Existing restore/notification/widget callbacks and permanent-delete confirmation remain; multi-item confirmation button is Delete, without Selected prefix.
behavior.excluded_action: User-requested delete-shaped icon with Restore tooltip; reuses allowExcludedTaskSync (ignored -> unreviewed, no immediate Task creation). It does not hard-delete source data.
behavior.select_all: All filtered/date-matching rows, including off-screen rows, only within current scope. Mixed state supported; label is 모두 선택 / 모두 해제. Zero selection disables action icons.
behavior.exit: Header arrow and Android back clear selection only, restoring original toolbar/list. Scope/tab changes also clear selection. Pending bulk operations disable selection/actions/back.
behavior.bulk: Reuse existing per-item callbacks. Partial success possible; remove successful IDs from selection, retain failed visible sources/tasks and allow retry. No new DB transaction or repository API.
behavior.preserved: Home CRUD, trash swipes outside selection, period/view persistence, excluded all-date scope and temporary sort, import/session/notification behavior.

limits: In-memory Drift/widget tests and mock eCampus flows; no real account or installed Android validation.
